exams.title: Recognized Examinations / Diplomas | Boğaziçi University
quotes: Applicants must submit at least one of the following examination or diploma results with the minimum required scores at the time of application.
SAT (Scholastic Aptitude Test) Faculty of Engineering: Minimum Total Score 1350/1600 and Math 700/800
International Baccalaureate (IB) Minimum IB Diploma Diploma Score of 36/45
GCE AL (General Certificate of Education Advanced Level) A grade in minimum 3 subjects relevant to the program applied for
Pakistan Higher Secondary School Certificate (HSSC) Minimum overall success rate of 80% For Engineering and Science programs, a minimum of 75% in both Mathematics and Physics is required

program.name: Civil Engineering
program.summary: Civil Engineering (B.S.), Faculty of Engineering, Boğaziçi University, Istanbul; taught in English.

costs.note: USD 10,000 a year for the Faculty of Engineering (fee page); the 2026-2027 intake table gives USD 5,000 per semester. Boğaziçi gives no scholarships or financial aid to international students. Living costs aren't published on the pages read.

admissions.threshold: Civil Engineering: IB Diploma score of at least 36/45. These are Boğaziçi's minimum scores to apply; places are limited to the international quota.

english.min_score: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with Writing 6.5, or TOEFL iBT 4.5 overall with 4.5 in each section (from 12 June 2026); or Boğaziçi's own BÜYES/BUEPT exam.
